name: core
description: Hand-written: 46 short documents, paraphrase and keyword queries, and unrelated negatives.

docs.title: Radar range equation
docs.body: The maximum detection range of a radar grows with the fourth root of transmit power and antenna gain. Doubling the power therefore increases range by only about nineteen percent.

docs.title: Pulse repetition frequency and ambiguity
docs.body: A high pulse repetition frequency avoids Doppler ambiguity but causes range folding, because echoes from earlier pulses arrive after the next pulse is sent.

docs.title: Matched filter
docs.body: The matched filter maximises signal to noise ratio by correlating the received waveform with a time reversed copy of the transmitted waveform.

docs.title: Linear frequency modulated chirp
docs.body: A linear chirp sweeps frequency across the pulse, giving a large time bandwidth product. After pulse compression the range resolution depends on bandwidth, not pulse length.

docs.title: Antenna sidelobe levels
docs.body: Low sidelobes reduce clutter returns and jamming susceptibility. Amplitude tapering such as Taylor weighting trades main beam width for lower sidelobes.

docs.title: Noise figure of a receiver chain
docs.body: The Friis formula shows the first low noise amplifier dominates the cascaded noise figure, so its gain and noise figure matter most.

docs.title: Postgres composite index
docs.body: A composite index on user_id and created_at turns a slow sort and filter into an index range scan. Column order matters: equality columns first, range columns last.

docs.title: Database connection pooling
docs.body: Opening a connection per request exhausts the server. A pool reuses a bounded number of connections and queues the rest, keeping latency predictable.

docs.title: Optimistic concurrency with revisions
docs.body: Each row carries a revision number. An update succeeds only if the revision still matches what the client read, otherwise the client must re-read and retry.

docs.title: Write ahead logging in SQLite
docs.body: WAL mode lets readers proceed while a writer appends to the log file, which improves concurrency compared with the rollback journal.

docs.title: pgvector HNSW index
docs.body: An HNSW index gives approximate nearest neighbour search with high recall. Larger m and ef construction values improve recall at the cost of build time and memory.

docs.title: Database backup strategy
docs.body: Take a base backup plus continuous archiving of write ahead logs so the database can be restored to any point in time. Test restores regularly.

docs.title: Zero downtime deployment
docs.body: Roll out a new revision while the old one drains: readiness fails first, in-flight requests finish, and the load balancer stops sending new traffic.

docs.title: Docker image size
docs.body: Multi stage builds keep compilers out of the final image. Install only runtime dependencies and run as a non root user to shrink size and attack surface.

docs.title: Secrets management
docs.body: Never bake credentials into images or source control. Inject them at runtime from a vault or the platform's secret store and rotate them regularly.

docs.title: Health checks
docs.body: Liveness tells the orchestrator when to restart a process; readiness tells the load balancer when to send traffic. Keep them separate and cheap.

docs.title: Infrastructure as code
docs.body: Describe cloud resources in declarative templates kept in version control, so environments are reproducible and changes are reviewed.

docs.title: Log aggregation
docs.body: Ship structured json logs from every instance into one searchable store with retention limits, and include a request id for tracing.

docs.title: OAuth with PKCE
docs.body: Public clients must use the authorization code flow with PKCE so an intercepted code is useless without the verifier that only the client holds.

docs.title: Refresh token rotation
docs.body: Issue a new refresh token on every use and invalidate the old one. If an old token appears again, revoke the whole family because it was likely stolen.

docs.title: SQL injection prevention
docs.body: Always bind values as parameters instead of concatenating them into SQL text. Validate identifiers against an allow list.

docs.title: Content security policy
docs.body: A strict policy forbids inline scripts and framing, limiting the damage of cross site scripting and clickjacking.

docs.title: Rate limiting
docs.body: Token buckets allow short bursts but cap sustained request rates per client, protecting anonymous endpoints from floods.

docs.title: Least privilege access
docs.body: Grant each service account only the permissions it needs, scoped to the narrowest resource, and review grants periodically.

docs.title: Asyncio task cancellation
docs.body: Cancelling a task raises CancelledError at its next await. Clean up in finally blocks and never swallow the exception unless you re-raise it.

docs.title: Python type checking with mypy
docs.body: Strict mode flags untyped definitions and implicit Any. Protocols describe structural interfaces without inheritance.

docs.title: Dataclasses with slots
docs.body: Frozen dataclasses with slots are immutable and use less memory than ordinary classes, which suits value objects created in large numbers.

docs.title: Packaging with uv
docs.body: uv resolves and installs dependencies quickly and writes a lock file so every machine gets identical versions.

docs.title: Property based testing
docs.body: Hypothesis generates many inputs and shrinks failures to a minimal example, finding edge cases humans do not think of.

docs.title: Python profiling
docs.body: Use cProfile to find hot functions and py-spy to sample a running process without restarting it.

docs.title: Embedding similarity search
docs.body: Texts are mapped to vectors and compared by cosine similarity, so passages with similar meaning are close even when they share no words.

docs.title: Overfitting and regularisation
docs.body: A model that memorises training data performs poorly on new data. Weight decay, dropout and early stopping reduce overfitting.

docs.title: Retrieval augmented generation
docs.body: Retrieve relevant documents first and place them in the prompt so the language model answers from supplied evidence instead of memory.

docs.title: Quantisation of models
docs.body: Converting weights from sixteen bit floats to eight bit integers shrinks the model and speeds up inference on CPUs with small accuracy loss.

docs.title: Evaluation metrics for retrieval
docs.body: Recall at k measures whether a relevant item appears in the top results. Mean reciprocal rank rewards placing it near the top.

docs.title: Chunking documents
docs.body: Split long documents into passages of a few hundred words with some overlap so each embedding captures one idea.

docs.title: Sourdough starter care
docs.body: Feed the starter equal weights of flour and water daily at room temperature. It is ready when it doubles within six hours of feeding.

docs.title: Searing steak
docs.body: Pat the meat dry, heat the pan until smoking and avoid moving the steak so a brown crust forms through the Maillard reaction.

docs.title: Cooking pasta al dente
docs.body: Salt the boiling water generously and taste a minute before the packet time. Reserve a cup of starchy water to loosen the sauce.

docs.title: Knife sharpening
docs.body: A whetstone at roughly fifteen degrees restores the edge. Finish with a honing rod and test by slicing paper cleanly.

docs.title: Packing light for travel
docs.body: Choose a single colour palette, roll clothes and carry only a cabin bag. Laundry on the road beats carrying extra outfits.

docs.title: Time zone jet lag
docs.body: Shift sleep a few hours per day before departure and get morning daylight at the destination to reset the body clock faster.

docs.title: Train tickets booking
docs.body: Regional train tickets are cheapest booked weeks ahead, while flexible fares allow changes. Compare with coach prices for long routes.

docs.title: Hiking safety
docs.body: Check the forecast, tell someone your route, carry water and a map, and turn back before dark if the trail takes longer than planned.

docs.title: Meeting notes template
docs.body: Record decisions, owners and deadlines first and discussion second, so people who skim still find what they must do.

docs.title: Code review etiquette
docs.body: Review the change not the person, explain why, offer alternatives and approve quickly once the main concerns are resolved.

docs.title: Estimating work
docs.body: Break tasks into pieces under a day, include testing and review time, and add a buffer proportional to uncertainty rather than padding everything.

docs.title: On-call handover
docs.body: End each shift with a written summary of open incidents, mitigations in place and next steps so the next engineer starts informed.
